name: Microscope Adventure Summer Camp
what_you_do: A weeklong day camp. You use light microscopes and Hamline's scanning electron microscope. Then you make microscope images in teams and show them.
who_can_apply: Students entering or in grades 9 to 12.
pay_detail: $598 before April 30; $698 after. Need-based scholarships can cover full tuition.
duration: 1 week, July 12 to 16, 2027, 9 am to 5 pm
deadline_text: Registration opens Monday, Oct 26 (2026, since the camp is in July 2027). Scholarship application due March 30, 2027.
how_to_apply: Use the Apply or Request Info links on the camp page. For a scholarship, show proof of SNAP, TANF or FDPIR benefits (or tax forms) and proof of at least a C average in science.
notes: The page gives no year for the Oct 26 open date; Oct 26, 2026 is a Monday, which matches.
